title: Tears of Steel
credit: Tears of Steel (CC) Blender Foundation | mango.blender.org. Excerpt cut, scaled to 1920x858 and re-encoded for this comparison.
clip_label: a 90-second Tears of Steel clip at 1080p

window.story_span: master 60 s, 12672 frames (tier L: past the opening, before the credits)
window.rule: the 90 s centred on the midpoint of the story span, fixed before viewing; not chosen by shot or by score

yah265.version: yah265 0.0.1 - H.265/HEVC encoder - Copyright 2026 the yah265 authors - https://github.com/terranvigil/yah265 - options: preset=medium rc=crf crf=25.00 sar=858:857

x265.threads: encoder default (pools and frame threads auto)

match.rule: x265 CRF solved in steps of 0.1 until the MP4 is within 2% of yah265's MP4 (log bytes linear in CRF; the enclab testbench's matched-size rule)

vmaf.method: every frame; reference and distorted both fed as yuv420p10le y4m through fifos; native 1920x858 (already fits 1920x1080, no upscale); CAMBI told enc_bitdepth=8, enc 1920x858; p5 is numpy-style linear percentile
